sources.title: HBM3e & GPU Memory: Why It Decides Your Model Size
sources.snippet: A GPU's high-bandwidth memory (HBM) sets two things: capacity decides which models fit, and bandwidth decides how fast they run. Because large language models are memory-bound — their speed is limited by moving weights and cache, not by raw math — memory is usually the deciding spec, not FLOPS.
